description: Market-Based Power System Test Cases Data is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Venkat Durvasulu. This dataset is aimed to provide the required data to equip the test cases to perform similar to a real electricity market. Datasets have been derived from multiple federal websites and electricity market sources used to augment the existing test cases to replicate the dispatch of a real electricity market. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
